lines.text: Nebuchadnezzar made Zedekiah king of Judah, and Zedekiah sent Jehucal and Zephaniah to ask Jeremiah to pray for them.
The LORD said the Chaldeans, who had withdrawn, would return, capture Jerusalem and burn it down.
Jeremiah left Jerusalem for Benjamin, but Irijah, the captain of the guard, seized him at the Gate of Ephraim.
Irijah took Jeremiah to the priests, who beat him and jailed him in the house of Jonathan the scribe.
Zedekiah questioned Jeremiah privately, then had him placed in the courtyard of the guard with a daily loaf of bread.
